postconditions.statement: IMPLEMENTER_RESULT returned with no unresolved blockers
the mechanical/agent-supplied partition is documented as literal section headings, enumerating which fields belong to which bin

the retirement POLICY is stated explicitly: retired means excluded from ordinary rhyme-search and RETAINED in history; never deletion or truncation; a non-empty reason is required. The retirement LAYOUT is documented as an OPEN SEAM, both options named, neither chosen, with a pointer that it is held for human ratification

a concrete field-by-field Stratum A mapping is present (identified assertion, source, supporting/challenging evidence, qualitative weak/medium/strong strength) with lifecycle standing shown as a SEPARATE dimension from belief strength - a real mapping against a worked example, not a promise

each of the five agent-supplied fields is individually addressable as an assertion with its own standing, so one may be disputed while another stays active WITHOUT rewriting the record; mechanical facts stay flat key-value lines carrying no strength or standing

THE STORE LIVES AT A GIT-TRACKED PATH, and the doc says why. Verified at HEAD: .agent-work/ is gitignored at .gitignore line 1 and has ZERO tracked files, so a store placed there is NOT Markdown in git and would be destroyed with the worktree - directly violating decision:markdown-in-git, the one settled storage ruling. All four design candidates placed it there by inheriting the location from LESSONS.md, which is a deliberately transitory inbox; the episode store is the opposite, explicitly outliving its consolidation. Store root resolves through ONE named seam pointing at a tracked path, and must NOT call durable_root()

the doc states the store is mechanical and never guesses - no ranking, no similarity, no embedding; rhyme detection is a downstream sensor job owned at #308. It also states the obligation on issue #300 manifest: an enumerable set of (loaded-artifact-id, canonical-revision) pairs

the episode-id scheme is chosen ON ITS OWN MERITS and the reasoning recorded, NOT cited as a panel finding - the Admiral retracted that unanimity claim (only 2 of 4 candidates used run-id plus sequence; B and C used descriptive slugs)

the doc states how cross-worktree sharing actually works now that the store is tracked: through GIT ITSELF (commit on a branch, merge to main, visible in every worktree and every later clone), which needs no durable_root(), is unaffected by the epic-lease exception, and is unaffected by the read-only fence on the main checkout since each commander writes only its own worktree

docs/EPISODE_STORE.md exists AND the store path is genuinely git-tracked (git does not track empty directories, and .agent-work/ is ignored outright, so this check is what proves the store is really in git rather than nominally so), and the broader suite is still green

check.command: test -f docs/EPISODE_STORE.md && git ls-files episodes | grep -q . && python -m pytest tests/ -q

the retire op layout effect routes through ONE named adapter seam with both candidate layouts documented and NEITHER hard-coded, so binding the ratified answer at g4 changes exactly one function

a seeded episode is retrievable across a genuine session boundary - written by one process, read by a separately-launched one sharing only the working tree - EXERCISED as a test, not asserted

NON-FORECLOSURE IS EXERCISED, not documented - the pre-ruled priority-1 obligation.
